create_runner: create a runner for running a shell command with PTY, WinPTY, or pipe fallback
run_PtyRunner: run a shell command under a Unix pseudo-terminal with output logging and user switching
run_PipeRunner: run a shell command with cross-platform stdin/stdout/stderr pipe redirection
run_WinPtyRunner: run a shell command under a Windows pseudo-terminal via pywinpty
review_ProcessRunner: review the abstract ProcessRunner base class with unified subprocess interface
